==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A glowing blue jelly cube leaped out of my hands. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
Johnson and I followed it to a fissure in a stone full of different colored glowing jellies. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.)
Johnson warned me not to go in there as Jelly World is unpredictable and dangerous.
